note: L2 check 3 (Right product). A user question, and the product the code step (ambiguousProducts, as listProducts runs it) must route it to. 'settled': exactly one product. 'clash': these products share the words, so the AI must ask the user. 'unknown': no word belongs to any product. 'known': the routing is wrong today; the case does not block, and it fails when the routing becomes right, so the field gets removed. Runs on the shipped indexes in the local and remote profiles (tests/tools/productRoutingEval.test.ts).
